title: Cargo.toml version not bumped despite breaking changes to public structs
description: jmap-types is published on crates.io at 0.1.1 (cargo search confirms). Recent commits add new public fields to multiple types: GetResponse.extra, ChangesResponse.extra + updated_properties, SetResponse.extra, QueryResponse.extra, QueryChangesResponse.extra, AddedItem.extra, JmapRequest.extra, JmapResponse.extra (bae3a90), plus SetResponse/ChangesResponse/QueryResponse/QueryChangesResponse field-type changes String → State (f084943, 25e5021), plus SetError.extra HashMap → Map (9c66783). All structs are #[non_exhaustive] so adding fields is SemVer-permitted, but the State newtype change breaks downstream String-typed bindings. Cargo.toml still says version = "0.1.1". External consumers pinning to 0.1.1 will silently get the new behavior. Fix: bump to 0.1.2 (still 0.1.x so technically pre-1.0 anything-goes, but a bump signals intent) and add a CHANGELOG entry. This will be a recurring class of issue: any future field/type change here needs a coordinated version bump.
close_reason: Versions bumped (0.2.0 in 0fb9bbd2) and CHANGELOG.md added in 65ea6584 with the 0.2.0 jmap-types breaking-change entry.
